snippet.title: Eight Mini Racers - PC Gameplay (Steam)
snippet.description:
1 - 8 player local multiplayer 2D top-down racing game. Racing, rockets, mines, steering failure, engine failure, repair kits, speed boosts and up to 8 players.

Developed by David Mulder
Published by SA Industry
